title: Three Tips to Avoid Guitar Finger Pain (Beginner)
summary: JustinGuitar’s beginner-focused segment on finger pain presents a practical, evidence-based approach to building a sustainable early practice routine. The core guidance includes: press lightly only when producing a sound, position fingers close to the frets to reduce required pressure, and adopt a paced practice schedule (about 20 minutes per day, four days a week) with built-in breaks. He also advises pausing when pain arises, massaging or rubbing fingers during breaks, and maintaining a positive mindset to keep playing enjoyable while calluses form. The transcript maps these suggestions to concrete verbal instructions and timing cues throughout the video.
